page.overview:
What is Ute Ute no Mi?

The Ute Ute no Mi is a non-canon Paramecia-type Devil Fruit that allows the user to turn anything into a gun, making them a . It was eaten by Bad One Gracie.

The fruit's main strength is turning anything around the user into a gun or cannon. Any object such as a block of wood, a coffee mug, or a saber can be transformed into a firearm. Once awakened, it could turn surrounding areas or surfaces into firearms as well, including the sea, walls, and an entire island.

The main weakness of the fruit is that it permanently turns the user's hands into guns. Otherwise, the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses apply.

Gracie uses his abilities to produce guns and cannons and fire ammunition from them in bursts. He was also able to awaken the fruit's abilities.
